cues.text: Hello?
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Oh hello. My name's Jan.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Are you the right person to talk to about the Buckworth Conservation Group?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Yes, I'm Peter. I'm the secretary.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Good. I've just moved to this area, and I'm interested in getting involved.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: I was in a similar group where I used to live.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Could you tell me something about your activities, please?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Of course. Well, we have a mixture of regular activities and special events.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: One of the regular ones is trying to keep the beach free of litter.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: A few of us spend a couple of hours a month on it, and it's awful how much there is to clear.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: I wish people would be more responsible and take it home with them.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: I totally agree.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: I'd be happy to help with that.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Is it OK to take dogs?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: I'm afraid not, as they're banned from the beach itself.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: You can take them along the cliffs, though. And children are welcome.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: We also manage a nature reserve, and there's a lot to do there all year round.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: For example, because it's a popular place to visit, we spend a lot of time looking after the paths and making sure they're in good condition for walking.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: I could certainly help with that.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Good. And we have a programme of creating new habitats there.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: We've just finished making and installing nesting boxes for birds to use, and next we're going to work on encouraging insects - they're important for the biodiversity of the reserve.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: They certainly are.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Oh, and we're also running a project to identify the different species of butterflies that visit the reserve.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: You might be interested in taking part in that.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Sure. I was involved in something similar where I used to live, counting all the species of moths.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: I'd enjoy that.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Another job we're doing at the reserve is replacing the wall on the southern side, between the parking area and our woodshed.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: It was badly damaged in a storm last month.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: ОK.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Then as I said, we have a programme of events as well, both at the weekend, and during the week.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Right. I presume you have guided walks?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: I'd like to get to know the local countryside, as I'm new to the area.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Yes, we do.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: The next walk is to Ruston Island, a week on Saturday.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: We'll be meeting in the car park at Dunsmore Beach at low tide - that's when the sands are dry enough for us to walk to the island without getting wet.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Sounds good.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: The island's a great place to explore.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: It's quite small, and it's got a range of habitats.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: It's also an ideal location for seeing seals just off the coast, or even on the beach.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: OK. And is there anything we should bring, like a picnic, for instance?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Yes, do bring one, as it's a full-day walk.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: And of course it'll be wet walking across and back, so make sure your boots are waterproof.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: I must buy a new pair - there's a hole in one of my current ones!
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Well, I'd definitely like to come on the walk.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Great. Then later this month we're having a one-day woodwork session in Hopton Wood.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: I've never tried that before.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Is it OK for beginners to take part?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Definitely. There'll be a couple of experts leading the session, and we keep the number of participants down, so you'll get as much help as you need.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: Excellent! I'd love to be able to make chairs.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: That's probably too ambitious for one day!
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: You'll be starting with wooden spoons, and of course learning how to use the tools.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: And anything you make is yours to take home with you.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: That sounds like fun. When is it?
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: It's on the 17th, from 10 a.m. until 3.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: There's a charge of £35, including lunch, or £40 if you want to camp in the wood.
cues.speaker: PETER

cues.text: I should think I'll come home the same day.
cues.speaker: JAN

cues.text: Well, I'd certainly like to join the group.
cues.speaker: JAN
